info.title: Hypersender SMS API Docs
info.description:
Send and receive SMS through your own Android phone and SIM card with the Hypersender SMS API.

**Base URL**: `https://app.hypersender.com/api/sms/v1/{instance}`. Replace `{instance}` with the Instance ID from the dashboard.

**Authentication**: send the instance API Key as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

**The Android app**: install Hypersender SMS from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hypersender.app&hl=en) and link it to your instance. See the [SMS quick start](https://docs.hypersender.com/v2/hypersender/overview/sms/sms-quick-start).

**Quick demo**: [Send an SMS in Postman](https://docs.hypersender.com/v2/api-reference/sms/how-to-send-an-sms-message-in-postman).

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format, for example `+12025550147`. Spaces, dashes, dots, and parentheses are removed first. The result must match `^\+?[0-9]{3,20}$`.

content.description: The SMS text. Up to 1600 characters. Long text is sent as a multipart SMS.

request_id.description: Your own ID for this message. Retrying with the same `request_id`, `to`, and `content` returns the existing message with status 200 and does not send it again. If you leave it out, a UUID is generated.

schedule_send_at.description: Send the message later. Format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` in the phone's timezone. Must be in the future and less than 3 days ahead.

max_send_attempts.description: How many times Hypersender tries to push the message to the phone. Defaults to the instance setting.

message_expiration_seconds.description: How long the message stays valid, in seconds. If the phone has not sent it by then, it expires. Useful for one-time codes. Defaults to the instance setting.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Instance UUID copied from hypersender dashboard

post.description:
Send an SMS through the Android phone linked to your instance, now or up to 3 days ahead. The API answers before the phone sends the message: follow the result with webhooks.

A retry with the same `request_id`, `to`, and `content` returns the existing message with status 200 instead of creating a new one.

parameters.description: Heartbeats per page. Default 50, maximum 50.

parameters.description: Range of when the heartbeat was last updated, separated by a comma.

parameters.name: filter[message_thread_id]
parameters.description: Messages in one thread. Exact match.

parameters.name: filter[from_phone_number]
parameters.description: Sender number or name. Exact match, for example `+12025550188`.

parameters.name: filter[to_phone_number]

parameters.description: `sent` for messages you sent, `received` for incoming messages.

parameters.name: filter[delivered_at]
parameters.description: Delivery time. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: filter[received_at]
parameters.description: Time the phone received the message. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: filter[expired_at]
parameters.description: Expiry time. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: filter[failed_at]
parameters.description: Failure time. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: filter[schedule_send_at]
parameters.description: Planned send time. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: filter[created_at]
parameters.description: Time Hypersender stored the message, not when it was sent or received. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: filter[updated_at]
parameters.description: Last update time. Range down to the minute, separated by a comma. Example: `2026-11-19 10:00:00,2026-11-19 10:20:00`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default `-updated_at` (newest first). Allowed: `created_at`, `updated_at`, `delivered_at`, `received_at`, `expired_at`, `failed_at`, `schedule_send_at`. Add `-` for descending.

delete.description: Delete a thread and every message in it. This cannot be undone.

request_id.description: The `request_id` you sent, or a generated UUID.

phone.description: The phone. Present on the send response, in some webhooks, and with `include=phone`.

from_phone_number.description: Sender. For received messages this can be a name, such as a bank or carrier.

tags.description: Lowercase tags added by rules on the phone. Empty list when no rule tagged the message.

schedule_on_phone_at.description: When the message was pushed to the phone.

sent_at.description: When the phone handed the message to the carrier.

received_at.description: When the phone received an incoming message.

schedule_send_at.description: Planned send time (UTC), for scheduled messages.

send_attempt_count.description: How many times Hypersender pushed the message to the phone.

failure_reason.description: Why the message failed, for example `GENERIC_FAILURE`, `NO_SERVICE`, `PHONE_DID_NOT_RESPOND`, or `Max send attempts reached`. Treat it as text: new values can appear.

ussd_message.description: USSD or flash reply the phone received for this message.

message_expiration_seconds.description: `0` means the message does not expire.

timezone.description: Timezone used to read `schedule_send_at` in the send request.

sim.description: For received messages, the SIM that received it. For sent messages, the instance's SIM.

type.description: `sent_to_mobile` for messages you sent, `received_from_mobile` for incoming messages.

app_version.description: The installed app version. Only present with `include=phone.currentAppVersion` and in some webhooks.

push_registration.description: Whether Hypersender can push messages to the phone.

status.description: `missing` means sends are refused with `PHONE_PUSH_NOT_REGISTERED` until the app registers again.

recovery_required.description: `true` when the app must register again. Open the app on the phone.

synced_at.description: When the app last reported its registration (ISO 8601).

client_state.description: Registration state reported by the app.

app_update_required.description: `true` when the app on the phone must be updated. Requests that need the phone return `426` until it is.

sim.description: The SIM slot this instance uses.

message_expiration_seconds.description: Default `message_expiration_seconds` for new messages. `0` means messages do not expire.

last_missed_call_at.description: Legacy field. Missed-call tracking was removed.

timezone.description: The phone's timezone. `schedule_send_at` in send requests uses it.

local_timestamp.description: The phone's local time when it sent the heartbeat.

app_version.description: App version that sent the heartbeat.

errors.description: Validation errors by field. Each value is a list of messages.

code.description: Machine-readable reason, when there is one. Example: `PHONE_PUSH_NOT_REGISTERED`.

data.description: Extra details, for example the app versions on a `426`.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status. Present on errors returned by the SMS service.
